name: Brasserie de Monaco — Port Hercule brewery

sources.evidence: The current official Brasserie de Monaco site states that Monaco Beer is brewed on site at the Port of Monaco and lists Blonde, Blanche, Ambrée and seasonal beers. Its beer page explicitly describes malt crushing, mashing/infusion and filtration, fermentation, and beer maturation at the Monaco brewery.
Journal de Monaco records BRASSERIE DE MONACO as a SARL at 36, route de la Piscine, Monaco, whose corporate purpose includes a brewery with beer manufactured on site.
